cpu=int('$CPU'); load=float('$LOAD'); mem=int('$MEM')

import secrets
print(secrets.token_urlsafe(48))
PY
); fi; TMPE=$(mktemp); cat >"$TMPE" <<EOF
FRANK_VOICE_MACHINE_ID=andreas-maco

FRANK_VOICE_PERSON=andreas
FRANK_VOICE_DB_PATH=/var/lib/entityos/unified.db
FRANK_VOICE_BROKER_TOKEN=$TOKEN

UNIT=/var/lib/entityos/rootfs-run/etc/systemd/system/frankenstein-chatgpt-client.service; TMPU=$(mktemp); cat >"$TMPU" <<'EOF'

LEADER=$(machinectl show entityos -p Leader --value); [ -n "$LEADER" ]; sudo -n nsenter --target "$LEADER" --mount --pid --uts --ipc --net -- systemctl daemon-reload; sudo -n nsenter --target "$LEADER" --mount --pid --uts --ipc --net -- systemctl enable --now frankenstein-chatgpt-client.service >/dev/null; sleep 2; echo SERVICE=$(sudo -n nsenter --target "$LEADER" --mount --pid --uts --ipc --net -- systemctl is-active frankenstein-chatgpt-client.service);
# Health and canonical reentry smoke. The secret stays inside this process. No external network is contacted.
sudo -n nsenter --target "$LEADER" --mount --pid --uts --ipc --net -- env TOKEN="$TOKEN" python3 - <<'PY'

    r=urllib.request.Request(base+path,data=data,method=method,headers={'Authorization':'Bearer '+token,'Content-Type':'application/json'})
    with urllib.request.urlopen(r,timeout=8) as f: return json.load(f)

assert h.get('ok') and h.get('machine_id')=='andreas-maco' and h.get('owner')=='andreas' and h.get('person')=='andreas'

meta={'session_id':sid,'runtime_epoch_id':t.get('session',{}).get('runtime_epoch_id'),'identity_state':t.get('session',{}).get('identity_state'),'titan_bytes':len(t.get('titan_context') or ''),'emergent_bytes':len(t.get('emergent_context') or ''),'state_keys':sorted((t.get('state') or {}).keys()),'assembly_sha256':hashlib.sha256((t.get('identity_active_assembly') or '').encode()).hexdigest()}
print('REENTRY_SMOKE',json.dumps(meta,sort_keys=True))

PY
